newsitem.title: UK: SBC sets warrants on DTB-Bund-Futures.
newsitem.headline: SBC sets warrants on DTB-Bund-Futures.

text.p: Schweizerischer Bankverein (Deutschland) has issued 80 million American-style call and put warrants, in eight equal tranches, on DTB-Bund-Futures due June 1997 and September 1997, lead manager SBC Warburg said.
